name: Applicability Domain Benchmark for GNNs on Molecular Property Prediction
description: A comprehensive benchmark evaluating embedding-based applicability domain methods for graph neural networks on molecular property prediction tasks to assess reliability and generalization.
evaluation_method: ROC-AUC for classification tasks; RMSE/MAE for regression; calibration/coverage metrics for applicability-domain assessment
general_score_metric: ROC-AUC (primary for classification tasks; regression tasks report RMSE/MAE; applicability domain reported with coverage/calibration metrics)
reputation: New preprint (2026) targeted at molecular ML and cheminformatics researchers; limited community adoption so far.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark focused on GNNs for molecular property prediction and reliability; evaluates applicability‑domain methods using coverage/calibration and standard predictive metrics. May exhibit class imbalance and moderate dataset sizes; reproducibility depends on provided splits and preprocessing.
